newsitem.title: USA: Hain buys Heinz line, accretive at once.
newsitem.headline: Hain buys Heinz line, accretive at once.

text.p: The Hain Food Group Inc said Tuesday it had bought the Alba Foods product line from H.J. Heinz Co for an undisclosed amount.
Hain's chief financial officer, Jack Kaufman, said Hain expected the line to become immediately accretive to earnings.
Kaufman said Heinz had requested the company not publicize the sale price.
He also said the company would use a revolving credit line to pay for the purchase.
"We don't expect it to have an impact on earnings," he told Reuters.
In a statement, Hain said Alba Foods made regular and non-fat dry milk products, cocoa mixes and dairy shakes.
Hain Food is a specialty food company, making cakes, snack foods and other products.
